evidence.title: PDF Mavericks - Free Unlimited PDF Tools Online (No Sign-up)

name: PDF Mavericks
summary: 40+ free browser-based PDF, image and developer tools; everything runs client-side so files never leave the device.
description: A collection of 40+ tools that run entirely in the browser via pdf-lib and PDF.js: merge, split, compress, sign, watermark, crop, rotate, organize, add page numbers or Bates stamps, flatten, protect, unlock and repair PDFs; convert between PDF and Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Markdown, CSV, text or images; image tools (HEIC, WebP, AVIF, ICO, GIF, compressor, resizer, background remover) and developer tools (JSON, YAML, CSV, XML, JWT, Base64, hashes, regex tester). No signup, no upload, no fixed file size limit.
contains: 40+ browser-based tools across PDF, image and developer data
all processing client-side via pdf-lib and PDF.js; files never leave the device
free with no signup, no upload and no fixed file size limit
PDF tools: merge, split, compress, sign, watermark, crop, organize, page numbers, Bates, flatten, protect/unlock, repair
conversions: PDF to Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Markdown, CSV, text and images
image tools: HEIC/WebP/AVIF/ICO conversion, compression, resizing, background removal
developer tools: JSON/YAML/CSV/XML, JWT decoder, Base64, hashes, regex tester
India-specific tools such as Aadhaar number masking
